_purpose: PBT computation factors. Editable via admin/finance. Per Rule N1, all financial assumptions are configured here, not hardcoded in utils/.

_documentation.cost_of_funds_pct: Percentage of total deposits paid as interest expense (deposit cost of funds). Industry-typical: 2-5%. Bank-specific based on the deposit mix.
_documentation.lgd_pct: Loss Given Default percentage. Used to compute impairment charge from NPL Stage 3 outstanding. Basel default: 45%. Internal Risk Rating Bank (IRB) banks calibrate this to their portfolio.
_documentation.non_interest_other_pct: Uplift on fee income to estimate FX + investment income (which isn't in CBS accounts.csv directly). 15% means non-interest income = fee_income × 1.15. Calibrate to actual NFI composition over time.
